title: [perf] enable SDPA for single-token cached decoding
body:
## Problem and change

`Attention.forward` excludes single-token queries from SDPA, so cached autoregressive decoding always uses the manual attention implementation even when `flash_attn` is enabled.

Add a dedicated SDPA branch for a one-token query. The current query can attend to all preceding cached keys, so this branch uses `is_causal=False` and applies the supplied key-padding mask. This makes SDPA's available backends usable during cached decoding.

## Validation

Five CPU regressions passed: cached FP32, cached BF16, key padding, non-causal attention, and input/parameter gradient agreement with manual attention. On upstream `cc9629e5`, the four dispatch checks fail because SDPA is never called; all five pass with this change. Cache length and finite outputs are also checked. `git diff --check` and Python compilation passed.

A single-thread FP32 CPU microbenchmark at B=1, H=8, KVH=4, D=64 and cache length 2047 measured medians of 2.0919 ms for manual attention and 2.1517 ms for SDPA, with substantial variation between rounds. This does not demonstrate a CPU speedup. GPU performance was not measured.

Environment: Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0+cpu, transformers 4.57.6. The checks use small randomly initialized modules without downloaded weights or datasets.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 单 token 缓存解码启用 SDPA
evidence_zh: 让缓存解码使用 SDPA；输出与梯度对照通过。CPU 微基准未显示提速，未测 GPU。

title: [fix] reduce half-precision causal loss in float32
body:
## Problem and change

Calling a half-precision MiniMind checkpoint with `labels` outside autocast can produce an infinite causal language-model loss even when its logits are finite. The cross-entropy reduction currently receives FP16 logits directly; a sufficiently large batch overflows that reduction.

Convert FP16/BF16 loss logits to FP32 before cross-entropy. Returned model logits keep their original dtype, and FP32/FP64 loss inputs retain their precision.

## Validation

Three CPU regressions passed. A tiny FP16 model with vocabulary size 128 and a 1024-by-16 input batch returns `inf` on upstream `cc9629e5`; with this change its loss is finite and exactly matches cross-entropy computed from the same logits in FP32, with finite backward gradients. The other checks cover ignored labels with FP32 parity and preservation of FP64 loss dtype. `git diff --check` and Python compilation passed.

Environment: Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0+cpu, transformers 4.57.6. These checks use randomly initialized tiny models and require no pretrained weights, external dataset, or GPU.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 半精度因果损失以 FP32 归约
evidence_zh: 半精度溢出样例从 inf 恢复为有限值，并与 FP32 参考一致。

title: [fix] keep MoE routing probabilities in float32
body:
## Problem and change

The MoE router computes softmax in the autocast output dtype. For a sufficiently confident router, FP16 probabilities can underflow to zero and BF16 can round the winning probability to one. This can remove the task-loss gradient that the existing top-1 straight-through path is intended to preserve.

Compute both router softmax operations in FP32, including the detached-input top-1 path. Expert computation and the existing routing rule remain as configured.

## Validation

Three CPU regressions passed. Controlled top-1 routing fixtures reproduce a zero FP16 gate gradient despite loss scaling and a zero BF16 winning-expert gate gradient on upstream `cc9629e5`. Both gradients become finite and nonzero with this change. A separate FP32 top-2 forward/backward check confirms finite outputs and input gradients. `git diff --check` and Python compilation passed.

Environment: Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0+cpu, transformers 4.57.6. The mixed-precision checks use CPU autocast and small initialized modules. They establish the numerical correction; full training quality and GPU throughput were not measured.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: MoE 路由概率使用 FP32
evidence_zh: 避免低精度概率下溢或舍入到 1 导致的路由梯度丢失。

title: [fix] decode serialized tool calls in agent training history
body:
## Problem and change

`AgentRLDataset.parse_conversations` decodes serialized tool definitions but leaves serialized `tool_calls` as strings. When a multi-turn training history contains an earlier assistant tool call, the chat template receives a string where it expects a list of calls.

Decode string-valued `tool_calls` while copying each history message, matching the representation already handled by `SFTDataset`. Structured call lists pass through directly, and the source sample is preserved.

## Validation

The CPU regression uses the repository tokenizer and a multi-turn history containing a serialized tool definition, an assistant function call, a tool response, and a follow-up user message. Upstream `cc9629e5` leaves the call field as a string. With this change, the history renders identically to the equivalent structured input, includes the expected function name, and leaves the original record unchanged. The regression, `git diff --check`, and Python compilation passed.

Environment: Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0+cpu, transformers 4.57.6. No pretrained model or external dataset is needed.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 解析 Agent 历史中的字符串工具调用
evidence_zh: JSON 字符串形式与结构化工具历史生成相同模板，原始记录保持完整。

title: [fix] keep MoE routing regularization independent of distillation alpha
body:
## Problem

The distillation trainer adds the MoE auxiliary loss to CE, then multiplies that combined term by `alpha`. This silently scales the configured router regularization by the CE/KL mixing weight; `--alpha 0` disables it completely.

## Change

Mix the CE and KL losses first, then add the model's auxiliary loss with its configured coefficient. Dense students keep the same objective.

## Validation

Executed the real `train_epoch` function with a small differentiable CPU model and SGD. For an auxiliary parameter initialized to 0.3 with loss `p**2` and learning rate 0.05, the parameter update is 0.03 for alpha 0, 0.5, and 1. The upstream alpha=0 case produces no auxiliary update. This check isolates the loss composition; it does not claim a downstream training-quality benchmark.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 蒸馏路由正则与 alpha 解耦
evidence_zh: alpha 为 0、0.5、1 时，路由正则都产生预期的独立更新。

title: [fix] apply the configured autocast to the distillation teacher
body:
## Problem

`--dtype` controls the student forward, but the teacher forward runs outside the existing autocast context. A CUDA mixed-precision run therefore still executes the teacher in fp32. Applying autocast to the teacher also requires keeping probability and KL calculations in fp32.

## Change

Run the frozen teacher under the same autocast context as the student. Convert logits to fp32 before temperature scaling and softmax/log-softmax in the distillation loss, so the reduced-precision forward does not reduce the loss calculation's precision.

## Validation

Executed the real trainer with CPU bf16 autocast: teacher outputs use bf16, teacher gradients remain disabled, and student updates stay finite. A separate fp16 regression with logits +/-40000 and temperature 0.5 returns finite fp32 KL=40000 and finite gradients. No CUDA throughput or memory benchmark was run.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 蒸馏教师使用配置的混合精度
evidence_zh: 教师实际使用 bf16；概率与 KL 以 FP32 计算，极值损失与梯度有限。

title: [perf] stage native checkpoints on CPU before loading model weights
body:
## Problem

Several native loaders deserialize checkpoints onto the requested GPU while their model is still on CPU, copy those weights back into the CPU model, then move the model to the GPU. The PPO critic also keeps the temporary state dictionary alive after loading. These staging tensors consume device memory that the model does not need.

## Change

Stage the six affected training, evaluation, serving, and adapter checkpoint inputs on CPU. Release temporary state dictionaries once their weights have been copied. The model still moves to its requested device through the existing path.

## Validation

Exercised `init_model` with an actual serialized state dictionary while inspecting the staging device and tensor lifetime. The loaded weights match the saved weights exactly, and temporary checkpoint tensors are released before the model transfer. Checked all seven `torch.load` sites in the six affected files use CPU staging, including the existing resume-checkpoint loader. The upstream GPU-staging regression fails and the changed loader passes. GPU peak memory and throughput were not benchmarked.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: CPU 中转 checkpoint，及时释放权重副本
evidence_zh: 修复 6 个加载入口，验证权重逐位一致及设备转移前的临时张量释放。

title: [perf] release DPO reference logits before the policy forward
body:
## Problem

DPO extracts reference token log probabilities, but keeps both the reference output object and its full vocabulary logits alive through the policy forward and backward. Only the much smaller token log-probability tensor is needed after extraction.

## Change

Drop the reference output and logits immediately after computing reference log probabilities. The frozen reference computation and DPO objective are unchanged.

## Validation

Executed the real DPO training loop for two CPU steps. Weak references confirm the reference logits are released before each policy forward; the upstream loop still holds them at that point. The resulting parameter values match the upstream loop exactly. This verifies tensor lifetime and numerical equivalence, without claiming a GPU throughput measurement.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: DPO 提前释放参考模型 logits
evidence_zh: 策略模型 forward 前释放完整词表 logits，两步参数更新与原实现完全一致。

title: [fix] defer periodic checkpoints until gradient accumulation completes
body:
## Problem

When `save_interval` is not divisible by `accumulation_steps`, a periodic checkpoint can record a step whose gradients have not reached the optimizer. Gradients are not part of the saved checkpoint, so resuming from that step skips the corresponding training contributions.

## Change

Defer a save point inside an accumulation window to the next optimizer boundary. Keep the final partial-window checkpoint, after its optimizer update. Apply the same schedule to GRPO/agent rollout-policy refreshes.

## Validation

Executed the actual pretrain, SFT, LoRA, DPO, and distillation loops with 13 microbatches, accumulation=4, and save_interval=5. Checkpoints now occur at steps 8, 12, and 13, with no pending gradients; upstream saves at 5, 10, and 13. Resuming the first saved checkpoint produces parameters identical to uninterrupted training for all five loops. Checked the actual GRPO and agent save predicates produce the same boundary schedule. No distributed or GPU training benchmark was run.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 在梯度累积完成后保存 checkpoint
evidence_zh: 避免保存未提交梯度的中间状态；实际训练循环的恢复结果与连续训练一致。

title: [fix] preserve complete tool history in the web demo
body:
## Problem

After a tool call, the web demo saves `full_answer` as the final assistant message sent back to the model. That display string includes the earlier tool-call text and HTML result cards, although the actual assistant/tool messages are already in the conversation. The next question therefore receives duplicated calls and presentation markup. Trimming by raw message count can also leave a tool result without its original user question or assistant call.

## Change

Keep `full_answer` for display and store only the final model answer in the model conversation. Trim history at user-turn boundaries, retaining all assistant/tool messages belonging to the selected previous turns. The existing plain-chat history count still corresponds to user/assistant pairs.

## Validation

Executed the actual `main()` against deterministic UI, tokenizer, and streaming-model fixtures. On upstream `cc9629e5`, the saved assistant content contains the old `<tool_call>` and a `<div>` result card. With this change, the next prompt contains a complete user/assistant/tool/assistant turn and a plain final answer. Also checked zero history and ordinary alternating chat history. `git diff --check` passes.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 修正 Web 工具对话历史
evidence_zh: 模型历史不再混入 HTML 卡片或重复工具调用，并按完整用户轮次保留历史。

title: [fix] apply the web output budget to native generation
body:
## Problem

The web demo passes `max_length`, while the native MiniMind `generate()` exposed by a native Transformers export accepts `max_new_tokens` and ignores `max_length` through `**kwargs`. The output-length slider is consequently ignored for that supported model format, including generation after tool results.

## Change

Pass the selected output budget as `max_new_tokens`. Reuse that budget after each tool result as the prompt grows.

## Validation

A local regression executes the web `main()` and the real native MiniMind `generate()` with deterministic logits and the repository tokenizer. With a two-token budget and EOS scheduled at token five, upstream emits five tokens; this branch emits two. A tool-round fixture also verifies that both generation calls receive the selected budget. Tested on CPU with Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0 and Transformers 4.57.6. `git diff --check` passes.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 让 Web 输出长度预算生效
evidence_zh: 原生生成请求 2 token 时，输出从原先 5 个变为 2 个。

title: [fix] bound tool evaluation generation and call rounds
body:
## Problem

The API backend of `eval_toolcall.py` hardcodes `max_tokens=8192`, ignoring `--max_new_tokens` (default 512). In addition, `run_case()` keeps generating indefinitely when a model repeatedly requests tools, so one failing case can prevent the remaining evaluation cases from running.

## Change

Use the configured token budget for API generation. Add `--max_tool_rounds` (default 16) to bound tool execution rounds for both local and API backends. After the allowed tool results, the model gets one final response opportunity; another tool request ends that case with a clear limit message. A zero round limit performs no tool execution. Reject negative round limits and nonpositive token budgets at CLI parsing.

## Validation

A local regression records the actual `chat_api()` request: upstream sends 8192 for a requested budget of 7; this branch sends 7. Repeating-tool fixtures exercise the actual `run_case()` for both backends, including a zero-round limit. At a limit of two, exactly two tool rounds and three model calls occur. Python 3.12, CPU. `git diff --check` passes.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 工具评测遵守 token 和轮数预算
evidence_zh: API 使用 CLI token 预算；达到工具轮数上限后终止重复调用。

title: [fix] report length-limited API completions accurately
body:
## Problem

The chat API reports `finish_reason="stop"` even when generation only ended because `max_tokens` was exhausted. Clients cannot distinguish a complete answer from a truncated one.

## Change

Track generated token IDs in the streamer, excluding the prompt, and inspect the completion IDs for non-streaming responses. Report `length` when the requested budget is exhausted without EOS. EOS termination and completed tool calls retain their corresponding finish reasons, including EOS exactly at the budget boundary.

## Validation

Ran ten local HTTP cases through FastAPI with the real repository tokenizer and `TextStreamer`: budget exhaustion, EOS exactly at the boundary, early EOS, a shorter completion, and a completed tool call, each in streaming and non-streaming mode. Upstream reports `stop` for the truncated case; this branch passes all ten cases. Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0, Transformers 4.57.6, CPU. `git diff --check` passes.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: API 正确标记长度截断
evidence_zh: 流式与非流式区分 length、stop 和 tool_calls；10 个 HTTP 情形通过。

title: [fix] reject incomplete base weights during model export
body:
## Problem

Native Transformers export and base-plus-LoRA export load their base checkpoint with `strict=False`. A configuration with the wrong number of layers can silently leave complete layers randomly initialized or discard trained layers, then write an apparently successful model export.

## Change

Require the full base-model state dict to match before native export or before injecting LoRA adapters for merging. This validates base-model architecture and weights at the point where a complete base checkpoint is required.

## Validation

Used a real tiny MiniMind model and temporary checkpoints on CPU. Both export paths reject a missing complete layer, a missing projection, and an unexpected key before writing output. Valid native export retains every FP32 weight exactly, and a valid zero-delta LoRA merge retains the expected FP16 base values. Upstream silently exports the missing-layer checkpoint. Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0, Transformers 4.57.6. `git diff --check` passes.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 导出前严格校验完整基模权重
evidence_zh: 拒绝缺层、缺投影和多余键；完整导出及零增量 LoRA 合并数值正确。

title: [fix] serialize tool arguments exactly once in API responses
body:
## Problem

A generated tool call can contain `arguments` as an object or as an already serialized JSON object. `parse_response()` always applies `json.dumps()` directly. In the string case, the API returns doubly encoded arguments: the client's usual `json.loads(function.arguments)` returns another string instead of the argument object needed to execute the tool.

## Change

Decode string-valued model arguments before serializing the API's `function.arguments` field. Both response modes use this shared parser. Invalid serialized arguments follow the existing malformed-tool-block handling.

## Validation

Exercised the actual FastAPI endpoint with the repository tokenizer, real streaming decoder, and OpenAI SDK. Object and JSON-string inputs containing Chinese text, quotes, backslashes, and nested options produce the same object after one client-side decode in both response modes. Also checked omitted arguments and invalid JSON strings. Upstream fails the string-input case; this branch passes. Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0, Transformers 4.57.6, CPU. `git diff --check` passes.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 避免工具参数重复 JSON 编码
evidence_zh: 真实 SDK 解码后得到参数对象；字符串和对象形式在流式、非流式中一致。

title: [fix] preserve OpenAI text content parts in API prompts
body:
## Problem

OpenAI chat messages allow text content as a string or as an array of text parts. The API currently forwards arrays unchanged to MiniMind's chat template, which treats non-string content as empty. A valid text-parts request therefore silently loses the user's entire question before inference.

## Change

Normalize text parts in `ChatRequest.messages` into one string in their original order. Preserve ordinary strings, assistant `content=None`, and tool-call metadata. Unsupported image/audio parts and malformed text parts receive HTTP 422 before inference, so the text-only service does not silently drop those inputs.

## Validation

The installed OpenAI SDK's `ChatCompletionUserMessageParam` declares the string-or-content-parts input form. Eleven real FastAPI requests with the repository tokenizer verify identical model input IDs for equivalent string/text-parts prompts in both response modes, a tool-history round trip, and rejection of unsupported/malformed parts before model invocation. Upstream's rendered user turn is empty for the array request; this branch preserves the question. Also checked that normalization does not mutate caller messages. Python 3.12, PyTorch 2.6.0, Transformers 4.57.6, CPU. `git diff --check` passes.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 支持 OpenAI 文本分段输入
evidence_zh: 保留文本数组中的用户提问；不支持的内容类型明确返回 422，11 个 HTTP 请求通过。

title: [fix] apply the PPO critic final normalization once
body:
## Problem

`MiniMindModel.forward()` already returns states after the final RMSNorm. The PPO critic normalizes those states again before its value head. Once the learned normalization weights differ from one, this changes the critic features and applies the same learned scale twice.

## Change

Pass the backbone's final hidden states directly to the value head.

## Validation

Ran the real tiny MiniMind critic with nonuniform learned normalization weights and compared it to `value_head(backbone(...)[0])`. The upstream maximum value error was 0.277123; this branch matches exactly and produces finite gradients through the backbone and value head. This is a CPU numerical regression, not a downstream reward benchmark.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 移除 PPO Critic 的重复 RMSNorm
evidence_zh: 实际小模型中，对 backbone 加 value head 的最大偏差从 0.277123 变为 0。

title: [fix] stop PPO updates after the synchronized KL limit
body:
## Problem

A KL-limit violation sets the PPO loss to zero but continues through the remaining minibatches. AdamW still changes parameters through weight decay or existing optimizer state, so the early-stop threshold does not actually stop the update. The gradient-accumulation counter also survives across rollouts even though each rollout flushes its pending gradients.

## Change

Complete the current zero-gradient backward for the synchronized DDP path, then leave the minibatch loop before counting or executing another optimizer update. Construct the zero loss from model outputs rather than an already-overflowed probability ratio. Reset the accumulation counter at each rollout boundary, while preserving the existing flush for accepted pending gradients.

## Validation

Executed the actual PPO trainer with tiny MiniMind actor/critic models and AdamW. When the first minibatch exceeds the threshold, upstream performs four forwards and four optimizer updates; this branch performs one forward and zero updates, leaving weights unchanged. Also verified that a subsequent normal rollout trains, accepted pending gradients flush once after a later rejection, and gradients remain finite with an overflowing rejected ratio. CPU validation only; multi-rank execution was not run.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: PPO 达到 KL 阈值后停止更新
evidence_zh: 首次拒绝从 4 次更新变为 0 次；跨 rollout 残余梯度刷新也通过验证。

title: [fix] reject inconsistent SGLang rollout probabilities
body:
## Problem

The SGLang rollout adapter silently fills missing behavior-policy log probabilities with zero and trims extra values. PPO and GRPO then compute importance ratios from fabricated or misaligned probabilities. Unexpected response batch sizes instead fail later with unrelated indexing or empty-sequence errors, and nonfinite log probabilities can enter training.

## Change

Require one response per prompt, one finite numeric log probability per completion token, and reject malformed probability entries at the adapter boundary. Preserve valid probabilities and genuinely empty completions.

## Validation

Executed the actual adapter against deterministic HTTP-response fixtures. Missing, extra, and NaN log probabilities are rejected instead of being accepted. Empty or oversized response batches raise clear RuntimeErrors instead of later ValueError/IndexError failures. Valid token/probability triples, scalar probability entries, and an empty completion preserve their expected outputs. These checks do not require or claim a live SGLang server run.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 校验 SGLang rollout 概率完整性
evidence_zh: 拒绝 token/logprob 不匹配、非有限概率和错误 batch 大小；合法响应保持完整。

title: [fix] train generated turn endings in multi-turn agent rollouts
body:
## Problem

Agent rollouts retain generated EOS tokens and their behavior-policy log probabilities, but mask every generated EOS out of the policy objective. The agent therefore receives no policy-gradient signal for ending a tool-call or final-answer turn. Simply unmasking EOS would expose a second issue: a later global cutoff would discard all generated actions after the first turn's EOS.

## Change

Include every sampled response token, including its turn-ending EOS, in the existing response mask. Use that per-segment mask throughout the training objective instead of cutting the whole multi-turn rollout at its first EOS. Tool observations and prompt tokens remain excluded by the existing zero-valued mask segments.

## Validation

Executed the real rollout assembly with the repository tokenizer and a deterministic two-turn tool interaction. Upstream supervises zero of the two generated EOS tokens; this branch supervises both, keeps later-turn actions, and excludes tool observations. The resulting masked objective on a tiny real MiniMind model produces finite gradients. This validates token supervision and does not claim a trained-model reward improvement.

[Regression checks and recorded results](https://github.com/Afloat16/minimind/tree/verification/minimind-20261120/contribution-validation/2026-11-20).
summary_zh: 学习 Agent 每轮生成的结束符
evidence_zh: 两轮工具交互中参与监督的生成 EOS 从 0/2 变为 2/2，后续轮次动作保留。
